techs.name: G.E.C.K.
techs.quote: Garden of Eden Creation Kit. The rebirth of the civilization!

techs.name: Hazmat Suit
techs.quote: The only way to move through the Wasteland.

techs.name: Botany
techs.quote: Understanding what survives in the ash is the first step toward harvesting the future.

techs.name: Scavenging
techs.quote: One man's pre-war garbage is another man's power grid.

techs.name: Navigation
techs.quote: Who commands the sea has command of everything.

techs.name: Refrigeration
uniques: [10]% Food is carried over after population increases [in all cities]
techs.quote: Preserving the past is the only way to ensure we have a future.

techs.name: Ecology
techs.quote: Nature always finds a way. Unfortunately, sometimes it finds a way to grow two heads

techs.name: Fertilizers
techs.quote: Out here, nothing goes to waste. Not even what remains of the dead.

techs.name: Writing
techs.quote: The pre-war books and data is as valuable as gold nowadays...

techs.name: Roads
techs.quote: Roads, to rebuild society.

techs.name: Metallurgy
techs.quote: The old world left us plenty of scrap. What matters is knowing how to turn it into something useful.

techs.name: Pipe Weapons
techs.quote: What was that quote, about sticks and stones in the Fourth World War?

techs.name: Pre-salt Exploration
techs.quote: Even in the fucking nuclear holocaust, humanity can't let the oil go.

techs.name: Medicine
techs.quote: A civilization is measured not by how many people it can kill, but by how many it can keep alive.

techs.name: Chemistry
techs.quote: Every substance is a poison. The difference lies in the dose, the application, and who's holding the flask.

techs.name: Pipes and Wires
techs.quote: Water, electricity, communication. The foundations of civilization are hidden beneath our feet. Sometimes, literally.

techs.name: Ballistic Weaponry
techs.quote: Hunter Rifles, Grenades and what the fuck you want. History doesn't repeat itself but it often rhymes.

techs.name: Water Power
techs.quote: The river has been flowing long before us. It will be after us. Unless...

techs.name: Electricity
techs.quote: The lights of the old world went out. Someone has to turn them back on.

techs.name: Desert Power
techs.quote: The sun burns the wasteland without mercy. We might as well make it work for us.
